notices.title: Amber Warning (Be Prepared) - Thunderstorms (Today)
notices.text: There is an increased likelihood of severe lightning associated with thundershowers at several places in the following areas during the evening or night. Thundershowers accompanied by heavy rainfall of about 100 mm are likely at some places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-Western, Northern and North-Central provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Strong gusty winds of 60–70 kmph and very rough sea conditions can be expected temporarily during thundershowers in the sea areas. Status: Active. Valid until: 2026-11-09T23:59.
